about.text: Soft-white, smooth, creamy cheese has a mild flavor. It is eaten for breakfast or snacks. Pictured is spinach topped with Baladi.

sources.text: Fresh, unpasteurised, shelf life about 3 days; dipped briefly in brine; creamier than Syrian cheese
